ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: FY2025 DPS 2 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.5, 2026-06-30: 0.5) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.5, 2025-06-30: 0.5) — mixed basis: the full-year total is a paid fact and the quarters are declared facts, so the year-over-year change in the declared quarterly rate is applied to the paid total (a payment declared in one quarter and paid in the next can shift by a quarter)
dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2008-06-30..2026-06-30; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2007-12-31..2007-12-31, 1 facts); paid FY facts for 17 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no declared FY fact and no four declared quarterly facts (2008-12-31, 2009-12-31, 2010-12-31, 2011-12-31, 2012-12-31, 2013-12-31, 2014-12-31, 2015-12-31, 2017-12-31, 2018-12-31, 2019-12-31, 2020-12-31, 2021-12-31, 2022-12-31, 2023-12-31, 2024-12-31, 2025-12-31); the declared tag files quarterly facts in the last 8 quarters ending 2026-06-30, the paid tag only full-year facts — the quarterly tag is primary (the paid tag's full-year facts fill only fiscal years the declared tag does not cover)
dividends.frequency_basis: spacing of the latest 4 positive quarterly DPS facts (2025-06-30, 2025-09-30, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30); the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

dividend_yield.basis: FY2025 DPS 2 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.5, 2026-06-30: 0.5) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.5, 2025-06-30: 0.5) — mixed basis: the full-year total is a paid fact and the quarters are declared facts, so the year-over-year change in the declared quarterly rate is applied to the paid total (a payment declared in one quarter and paid in the next can shift by a quarter)

dividend_yield.note: FY2025 DPS 2 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.5, 2026-06-30: 0.5) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.5, 2025-06-30: 0.5) — mixed basis: the full-year total is a paid fact and the quarters are declared facts, so the year-over-year change in the declared quarterly rate is applied to the paid total (a payment declared in one quarter and paid in the next can shift by a quarter)

notes: split 5 tagged at 2015-06-17: facts filed before 2015-08-06 are on the pre-split basis — the diluted share count for the period ended 2014-06-30 was re-filed ×5.00 on 2015-08-06 (last filed on the old basis 2014-08-07)

annual_dps: FY DPS for the period ended 2013-12-31 is filed as 2.2 (10-K filed 2014-02-27, 10-K filed 2015-02-26) and as 0.44 (10-K filed 2016-02-25) — restated for the 5-for-1 split effective 2015-06-17 (first filed on the new basis 2015-08-06); 0.44 used (the latest filing on the new share basis, CommonStockDividendsPerShareCashPaid)

annual_dps: FY DPS for the period ended 2014-12-31 is filed as 5 (10-K filed 2015-02-26) and as 1 (10-K filed 2016-02-25) — restated for the 5-for-1 split effective 2015-06-17 (first filed on the new basis 2015-08-06); 1 used (the latest filing on the new share basis, CommonStockDividendsPerShareCashPaid)

split adjustment (declared DPS): 18 facts for periods ending 2008-06-30..2014-03-31 were last filed before the 5-for-1 split effective 2015-06-17 (first filed on the new basis 2015-08-06) and are divided by the filed ratio (StockholdersEquityNoteStockSplitConversionRatio1) to today's share basis

split adjustment (paid DPS): 12 facts for periods ending 2007-12-31..2014-03-31 were last filed before the 5-for-1 split effective 2015-06-17 (first filed on the new basis 2015-08-06) and are divided by the filed ratio (StockholdersEquityNoteStockSplitConversionRatio1) to today's share basis

dps_basis: declared facts for periods ending 2008-06-30..2026-06-30; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2007-12-31..2007-12-31, 1 facts); paid FY facts for 17 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no declared FY fact and no four declared quarterly facts (2008-12-31, 2009-12-31, 2010-12-31, 2011-12-31, 2012-12-31, 2013-12-31, 2014-12-31, 2015-12-31, 2017-12-31, 2018-12-31, 2019-12-31, 2020-12-31, 2021-12-31, 2022-12-31, 2023-12-31, 2024-12-31, 2025-12-31) — the series switches basis where one tag stops; the switch year can double-count or skip one payment (a dividend declared in one quarter and paid in the next)

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 2 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.5, 2026-06-30: 0.5) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 0.5, 2025-06-30: 0.5) — mixed basis: the full-year total is a paid fact and the quarters are declared facts, so the year-over-year change in the declared quarterly rate is applied to the paid total (a payment declared in one quarter and paid in the next can shift by a quarter)

frequency: the FY2025 total is a paid fact and the quarterly facts inside that year are declared facts — the payment count needs both from one tag, so the cadence is read from the spacing of the quarterly facts
